de.fedjapost.json

Class JSONArray

  • java.lang.Object
    • de.fedjapost.json.JSONArray

  • public class JSONArray
extends java.lang.Object
    Instances of this class represent an Array in JSON. This class allows you to parse and mutate arrays.
